resources.string: A remote for your parked adventures.
No infrared transmitter detected on this device.
Experimental • Hent compatibility has not been verified. All 13 original buttons are shown; buttons without codes do not transmit.

These codes were documented for a different model: Transcold M1-F-NO-6. A similar supplier name does not prove compatibility. Test one command at a time. No signal is sent by enabling this option. Lamp, Strong, Eco, Sleep and Display still need original codes.
Local Transcold settings only. The phone cannot read the actual AC state. Imported raw commands do not update these settings.
Point the top of the phone at the AC receiver.
No code is available for this button. Nothing was sent. Import a JSON profile containing its original raw infrared signal. The phone cannot learn codes by receiving infrared.
This carrier frequency is not supported by the phone.
Replace the current profile with “%1$s” (mapped: %2$d)? This does not transmit any commands.
Unable to read or write this file

Use a UTF-8 JSON profile with schemaVersion 1, name and commands. Each command needs frequencyHz and patternUs (positive integer microseconds, shorter than 2 seconds). Maximum file size: 1 MiB. See the repository documentation.

This app sends infrared using Android ConsumerIrManager. It does not receive or copy IR.

All 13 buttons follow the Hent product photo. Hent rooftop compatibility is unverified. Transcold is an enabled-by-default candidate for a different AC model, not an identified match. Missing codes are never guessed.

Import raw codes for any button. No internet, account, ads or analytics. Profiles and test results stay on this phone unless you export and share them yourself.

GPL-3.0-or-later. Transcold encoder adapted from IRremoteESP8266 (Chandrashekar Shetty, crankyoldgit, siriuslzx); see source notices. No affiliation with Hent, Xiaomi or Transcold.
